description: Play the game headless (like growblocks_check with play) with scripted input, and get screenshots over time plus the engine's own numbers each second (fps, draw calls, triangles from window.__gbtest). steps: e.g. "click 0.5,0.85; keys KeyW:1500,Space; drag 0.2,0.5>0.6,0.5; state boss; wait 2000" (positions under 1 are a share of the screen; state = a gb.dev.states name). shots: seconds to screenshot at ("3,12"). Returns the summary and the last screenshot; all shots and report.json are in a temp folder it names.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).

name: growblocks_playtest
title: Playtest headless
